description: Colour for the long trek before the ambush, and gossip the party can pick up in town afterwards. Roll or pick. Most are true; none of them name Selyse.
name: Desert Road Rumours

results.description: Three trade caravans have gone missing on this road in six months. The town guard filed reports on exactly none of them.
A merchant swears the bandit who robbed him was crying the whole time. Wouldn't meet his eye. Apologised.
Gold jewellery keeps turning up in the market at a third of its worth. Nobody asks where from. The captain of the guard wears a very fine pair of ear cuffs.
Scorpions have been coming up out of the sand closer to the road than anyone likes. Something drove them out of the deep dunes.
A goatherd points at a rockfall on the horizon and says it wasn't there last season. When you look again, you're less sure it's there now.
Someone in the tavern claims they saw a woman with the body of a lion drinking at the oasis at dusk. Everyone laughs. One person doesn't.
The guard captain personally 'investigated' the missing traders and closed the case in a day. She's been generous with drinks ever since.
Fresh palm leaves, cut and discarded, half-buried at the roadside. Nothing grows within a day's walk of here.
